cases.error_excerpt: File "<string>", line 2, in <module> ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'imp' ... ERROR: Failed to build 'crepe' when getting requirements to build wheel
cases.diagnosis: crepe<=0.0.12's legacy setup.py imports the 'imp' module, removed in Python 3.12. A gradio-SDK Space runs Python 3.12, so the build fails.
cases.fix: Deploy in dual-interpreter mode with an older backend_python (3.9) so 'imp' still exists.

cases.error_excerpt: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pkg_resources' ... ERROR: Failed to build 'crepe' when getting requirements to build wheel
cases.diagnosis: crepe imports pkg_resources at build time; setuptools>=81 removed it, and pip's isolated build env used a modern setuptools.
cases.fix: Pin setuptools<81 both in the venv and via PIP_CONSTRAINT for pip's isolated build environments (the dual Dockerfile does this).

cases.error_signature: librosa==0.10.1 because these package versions have conflicting dependencies
cases.error_excerpt: The user requested librosa==0.10.1; ddsp 3.7.0 depends on librosa<=0.10
cases.diagnosis: A pinned librosa version violated ddsp's declared librosa<=0.10 constraint; the pin was an LLM guess, not from ddsp's metadata.
cases.fix: Auto-repair via the PyPI dependency-conflict check: re-pin to librosa==0.9.2 (newest satisfying every declared bound + the numpy/numba floor).

cases.diagnosis: psutil is imported on the inference path but not declared in the repo's dependency manifests, so it was missing from backend_pip.
cases.fix: Add psutil==5.9.8 to backend_pip. A static import-graph scan of the inference entrypoint would have caught this before deploy.

cases.error_signature: does not appear to be a Python project
cases.error_excerpt: git+https://github.com/AMAAI-Lab/SonicMaster.git@main does not appear to be a Python project: neither 'setup.py' nor 'pyproject.toml' found.
cases.diagnosis: The repo has no root packaging file, so `pip install git+<repo>` cannot build it. A self-contained pyharp wrapper that imports it can't work.
cases.fix: Strip the doomed git+ line and deploy as a remote-backend proxy to the model's existing Gradio Space.

cases.error_signature: No matching distribution found for torch==2.4.0
cases.error_excerpt: ERROR: No matching distribution found for torch==2.4.0
cases.diagnosis: The authored recipe pinned a torch build not available on the Space's default index.
cases.fix: Proxy to the existing backend Space (remote mode) so the heavy/fragile torch pin stays on the backend.

cases.error_signature: gradio and huggingface_hub==1.20.1 because these package versions have conflicting dependencies
cases.error_excerpt: ERROR: Cannot install -r requirements.txt, gradio and huggingface_hub==1.20.1 because these package versions have conflicting dependencies.
cases.diagnosis: A freeze captured against gradio 6 carried huggingface_hub 1.x, which conflicts with pyharp's gradio==5.28.0.
cases.fix: Never transplant gradio-coupled infra packages from a freeze (the _FREEZE_BLOCKLIST); keep the Space's own declared constraints so pip resolves against gradio 5.28.0.
